description: This is a Kotlin source file defining the ConnectionManager class which manages network and device connection configurations, handling TLS parameters, device capabilities, and building connection options for gateway communication in an Android app.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: A class managing network connection settings, TLS parameters, and device capabilities for gateway communications in an Android environment.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for a given gateway endpoint based on stored fingerprints, manual TLS settings, and endpoint hints.

methods.name: runtimeFlags
methods.description: Collects device and app state flags to determine runtime capabilities and configuration.

methods.name: buildInvokeCommands
methods.description: Builds a list of commands to be advertised for invocation based on runtime flags.

methods.name: buildCapabilities
methods.description: Builds a list of capabilities to be advertised based on runtime flags.

methods.name: resolvedVersionName
methods.description: Returns the app version name with an appended '-dev' suffix if applicable.

methods.name: resolveModelIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the device model identifier from build properties.

methods.name: buildUserAgent
methods.description: Constructs a user agent string with app version and device info.

methods.name: buildClientInfo
methods.description: Builds client information for connection messages.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions
methods.description: Creates connection options for a node role gateway connection.

methods.name: buildOperatorConnectOptions
methods.description: Creates connection options for an operator role gateway connection.

methods.name: resolveTlsParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for a specific gateway endpoint by loading stored fingerprints and applying resolution logic.
